obligations.name: rank-one equivalence
obligations.evidence: All 3720 nondegenerate toy profile/permutation pairs satisfy affine iff rank one.
obligations.scope: Complete F_5 width-four census and linear-algebra proof.

obligations.name: S17 difference span
obligations.evidence: Toy rank is 3; both P-256 control fields have rank 16.
obligations.scope: All fixed eight-plus/nine-minus patterns over an odd field.

obligations.name: P-256 non-affine control
obligations.evidence: Half-turn image and planted augmented rows have rank 2, with 2 group replays and zero failures.
obligations.scope: Deterministic scalar labels, not actual factor-base logs.

obligations.name: one-dimensional non-affine image
obligations.evidence: Rank one on the full fixed-sum difference space is equivalent to affine log transport.

obligations.name: nonlinear restricted selector
obligations.evidence: A restricted nonlinear coefficient family may have a smaller image, but must measure yield and retain two-row rank.
obligations.scope: Outside the full fixed-sum linear-span theorem.

controls: Complete toy census: 156 profiles, 24 permutations, 468000 affine-slice rows.
Dual-field P-256 controls rank every matrix in both row orders and replay both planted group equations.
Rounds 39, 304, and 309 are imported only after exact hash, schema, curve, conclusion, and boundary checks.
cost_accounting: Measured: complete toy enumeration, bucket occupancies, span/rank operations, P-256 group replay, isolation telemetry, and artifact sizes.
Imported modeled boundary: Round 309 S17 product yield and balanced arity-40 projection; not reclassified as measurement.
Unset: a nonlinear restricted family, its yield and degree, relation collection, sparse linear algebra, and recovery.
exploration_boundary: Exact for linear product images induced by arbitrary permutations on the complete fixed-sum coefficient span; not a universal bound on nonlinear or restricted coefficient families.
weakest_open_obligation: Construct a nonlinear restricted coefficient family whose joint image is near size n, whose two augmented rows stay independent, whose retained yield is exhaustive, and whose structured degree is at most five.
narrowest_supported_finding: No same-base column permutation can give both a globally one-dimensional joint coefficient image and two independent useful rows: rank one is exactly affine log transport; non-affine transport has rank two.
